title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out and about with Hishi Amazon…
I follow her gaze to see a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: My dorm's gonna get new students moving in soon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of getting 'em a little welcome gift or something. Those plushies'll probably work great, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! Okay, time to win all the plushies and empty out that machine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …Or so I'd like to, but I don't have the funds to play! Darn it all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What?! You'd really get them for me, Teach?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nice! Show me you're made of, then! Grab as many as you can!
There's no way I can fail!
